summary: Iter-16 (Seat suggestions + Session launch emails auto/manual + Badge wall celebration + Appeal template insights). Backend pytest 11/11 PASS after fix. Frontend: CRITICAL runtime bug found and fixed -- Admin > Programs crashed with 'iconBtn is not defined' whenever a cloned row rendered because LaunchEmailButton (AdminPrograms.jsx:233) referenced iconBtn which was only defined inside the sibling ProgramRow component. Added local iconBtn const inside LaunchEmailButton. After fix: program-launch-email-btn renders on cloned row (1 count), clone-program-dialog shows clone-seat-suggestion + clone-launch-auto/clone-launch-manual radios, clone-use-suggestion-btn appears when capacity differs from suggestion. Admin > Reports: template-insights card renders 2 template-row entries with template-top-tag on the best per_recipient row ($10 vs $2); 'matched by subject' label shown on subject-matched row; history-seat-suggestion present inside Forecast history. Backend behaviours confirmed: GET /api/admin/programs/{pid}/seat-suggestion returns suggested=15 with '+20%' explanation for 2 seasons (one fast-fill), 10 for slow-only, null for no history. GET /api/admin/programs/{pid}/history includes 'suggestion'. POST /clone validates launch_email (bogus->400) and returns launch_audience count. Manual launch flow: pre-publish launch POST -> 400; publish without auto-send; GET /launch pending=3; adding a signup in clone drops pending to 2; POST launch queued=2 and after ~4s session_launch_emails has 2 docs; re-POST -> 400. Auto launch on publish creates 2 session_launch_emails docs within ~4s and sets launch_sent=true; re-publish does not resend. _celebrate_badge_wall() upserts 1 badge_wall_notified doc per (email,scope,threshold) and skips existing; adding a second milestone creates exactly 1 more doc. Public /api/volunteer-hours/badge-wall never includes email/first/scope fields. GET /api/admin/reports/template-insights computes uses=1, per_recipient=10.0, top=true for qa-tpl-1 and uses=1, matched=1, per_recipient=2.0 for qa-tpl-2 matched by subject. POST /admin/scheduled-appeals persists template_id when provided.

ui_bugs.issue: 'iconBtn is not defined' runtime error crashed the entire Admin > Programs tab whenever a cloned program row was present (LaunchEmailButton used a const declared in sibling ProgramRow). Fixed by defining iconBtn inside LaunchEmailButton.

action_items: Review the iconBtn scope fix in AdminPrograms.jsx:233 (LaunchEmailButton). Consider hoisting iconBtn to module scope since it's now duplicated across LaunchEmailButton and ProgramRow -- single source of truth avoids future drift.
Prior iter-15 priority_until signup projection bug should still be verified (not in this iteration's scope).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 5283 lines. Seat suggestion + launch emails + badge wall celebration + template insights all land in the same monolith. Split into routers (programs_lifecycle, launch_emails, badge_wall, reports_appeals) before 6k.

LaunchEmailButton originally relied on a const from a sibling component -- a lint rule (no-undef) would have caught this at build time. ESLint config appears to not fail the build on no-undef. Consider enabling.

_celebrate_badge_wall uses db.badge_wall_notified.update_one upsert then counts docs for first_time -- correct, but 'first_time' race if hourly jobs ever overlap. Mark with a dedicated index on (email,scope,threshold) for correctness + perf.
_send_launch_emails sleeps 0.6s per recipient inside a BackgroundTask; for a 500-person audience that's 5 minutes blocking the worker. Fine for v1 but document the throughput ceiling.

_launch_recipients fetches all submissions in the family then filters -- for programs with thousands of signups this is O(N) per request. Add program_id + email compound index and query clone's signups via $nin instead.
_seat_suggestion computes ceil via `int(-(-n // 1))` which is clear but opaque; use math.ceil for readability.
appeal_templates.subject matching for insights uses .strip().lower() -- two templates with the same subject will silently collide (the later one wins in by_subject dict). Warn/dedup.

rca of the issue: AdminPrograms.jsx:248 referenced an identifier `iconBtn` that was only declared inside the ProgramRow component (line 252). In the previous iteration (iter-15) there were no cloned program rows rendered in the smoke test, so LaunchEmailButton was never mounted. In iter-16, after seeding a cloned program, React tried to render <LaunchEmailButton/> and threw 'iconBtn is not defined', unmounting the whole Programs tab. Fix: define `const iconBtn` inside LaunchEmailButton (one-line patch). Prevention: enable ESLint no-undef as an error in CI.
